## Projects

**Willamette Applicant Trajectory** — see the [Capstone page](capstone.qmd) for the full story.

- This project builds a predictive model that looks at an applicant’s profile characteristics and predicts which type of school they’re most likely to choose if not Willamette: another small private Northwest college, a large public university, or a local public or private school. The results of most common predictors offer general insight and can be utilized by Admissions to inform enrollment strategy. I served as the owner product lead, ensuring stakeholder alignment, and contributed to all aspects of the project including data cleaning, feature engineering, and model development.

**Willamette University Soccer Analytics (WUSA)** - see the [Projects page](projects.qmd) for full details.

**Temporal Trends in Forest Cover in the Nyungwe Nature Reserve** - see the [Projects page](projects.qmd) for full details.
